When you finally learn to be gentle with yourself

When you apologize first and the whole fight just dissolves

Me, instantly loyal to anyone who shows me basic decency
When the wifi connects on the first try and you feel chosen

When you finally let someone take care of you for once

the whole house needs to be awake

Me entering the weekend

exactly when I needed to relax

When the wifi comes back

Me charging into the fridge

Me entering the chat

Me getting out of bed
only because I smelled breakfast

The whole family watching dad
try to assemble the IKEA shelf

Everyone leaning in to read
the one typo in my message

Us tracking the pizza
like it's a live hostage situation

The squad calculating who owes what
after splitting the bill

Everyone staring at the loading bar
willing it to move faster

The group huddled over one phone
zooming in on a blurry photo

Us watching the microwave countdown
like it's a championship final

Everyone reading the text
before deciding how to reply

The team watching one guy
guess the wifi password

Us studying the menu
like it's a final exam

Everyone watching the new guy
try to start the office coffee machine

The crew analyzing the receipt
to find the hidden charge

Us watching the progress bar freeze
at ninety-nine percent

Everyone staring at the parking spot
debating if it fits

The whole office watching IT
turn it off and on again

Us decoding the cryptic email
the boss just sent

Everyone watching the egg timer
for the perfect boil

The group rereading the rules
before the board game starts

Us watching the gas gauge
on a road trip with no stations

Everyone watching one guy
parallel park on the first try

The team studying the spreadsheet
looking for the one wrong number

Us staring at the weather radar
planning the entire weekend

My credit card bill
showing up faster than my paycheck

The group project due tomorrow
that nobody has started

My alarm at 6 a.m.
coming for me like a missile

That email I left on read
finally demanding an answer

Friday energy
barreling straight into the weekend

The end of the free trial
arriving before I could cancel

My mom's text "call me when you see this"
hitting at full speed

Reality showing up
the second the vacation ends

The autopay I forgot to disable
draining my account on time

My to-do list
gaining on me with sirens blaring

Karma pulling up
right after I jinxed myself

The Sunday scaries
speeding in before bed

That awkward memory from 2014
ambushing me at 3 a.m.

My motivation, finally arriving
ten minutes after I gave up

The pizza guy
who found my house way too fast

My anxiety, right on time,
no warning, no brakes

The plot twist nobody asked for
racing into the season finale

My battery hitting 1%
right when I need the maps

The dentist reminder
catching me mid-snack

Adulthood, arriving early
and way too fast

The wifi cutting out
the instant the meeting starts

Consequences I was sure I'd outrun
catching up anyway

My brain when someone says
"you already met them, remember?"

Trying to do mental math
while everyone watches

Me reading the menu
for the eleventh time

When the cashier asks
"is that everything?"

My head when the wifi
goes out mid-thought

Trying to recall a password
I changed yesterday

When they say
"pick whatever you want"

My face when the joke
lands three seconds late

Reading the same paragraph
for the fifth time

When someone explains crypto
and expects a reaction

Me opening the fridge
for no reason at all

When the doctor asks
"any family history of this?"

My brain trying to convert
celsius to fahrenheit

When they ask which day
works best for me

Me, mid-sentence, forgetting
what I was about to say

When the meeting ends with
"so are we all aligned?"

Trying to remember if
I locked the front door

When the recipe says
"season to taste"

My face when the math
just isn't mathing

When someone asks my
wifi password out loud

Me staring at the form
that says "explain your reasoning"

When the GPS reroutes
and I have no idea why

Mall map: "You are here"
Guy: "And so am I, buddy"
